title: Japan Lost 1.6 Million Vending Machines And Still Has Millions
hook: Japan still has 4 million vending machines after a huge decline.
closing: Convenience stayed everywhere even as the machine count fell.
question: What would you buy from one?

segments.say: Japan lost 1.6 million vending machines, yet they still remain everywhere.
Japan has one machine for every 31 people, more than twice America's density.
Beverage machines total 2.2 million, so drinks dominate what these machines sell.
